exposure: factors influencing mode of delivery preference
cohort: A sample of 432 primiparous or para-one Jordanian women, aged 25-34 years and in their second or third trimester of pregnancy.
finding: Jordanian women preferred normal vaginal delivery, but many held incorrect beliefs about delivery methods, were not significantly involved in decision-making, and their knowledge varied significantly by geographic location and educational level.
cross-section timing: During the second or third trimester of pregnancy
gest_age: Second or third trimester of pregnancy
